title: Find a Men's Shed
summary: Find information and locations for Men's, Women's, and Community sheds in your local area.
intro:
Men’s, Women’s and Community sheds are non-commercial organisations started by volunteers in the local community. Sheds give members a safe space to make friends, talk, learn new skills and access health information.

You can use your postcode to Find a Men's Shed near you.

Women and Community sheds are increasing but may be harder to find and are dependent on volunteers starting them. Find out more, if you’re interested in starting a shed in your local community.

The Australian Men’s Shed Association (AMSA) is the national body supporting more than 1,200 Men’s, Women’s and Community sheds. You can find more information about how to run a shed and other helpful resources.
